transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I... well, I guess I'm just having a really hard time lately. 

Um... I've been getting these foreclosure notices. And ever since they started coming, I just... I feel like I'm coming apart at the seams. It's hard to talk about, but... I've been sitting in my truck crying before work. I jump every time the phone rings. And at the shop, I'm... I'm snapping at the apprentices. Making stupid mistakes in the repair bay that I never would've made before. 

I just... I don't know. That's why I'm here.
Have you been avoiding anything or any place because of your situation with the foreclosure notices?

I guess... yeah. I just... I haven't been going to things. 

I stopped showing up for church volunteering. And my fitness classes. I used to do these truck-club outings, but... I don't go to those anymore either. 

And at work... well, they actually took me out of the high-risk repair bay. So... yeah. I guess I've just been staying away from a lot.
Do you ever feel like you're outside of your body watching yourself?
No. I don't... I don't think so. I'm just here, in it.
Do you have any memories from the time you've been getting these foreclosure notices that feel foggy or unclear?
No, not really. I remember it all. I just... wish I didn't.
Do you feel detached from yourself or the world around you?
No, I don't think so. I'm just... I'm just dealing with my life right now. I don't feel detached.
Have you lost interest in things you used to enjoy?

Yeah, I guess. I just... haven't been doing much lately. I stopped showing up for church volunteering, and... my fitness classes. I used to go to these truck-club outings too, but I don't really do that anymore either. Even at work... they actually took me out of the high-risk repair bay. So... yeah.
Are there any activities that you still find pleasure in or look forward to?
Not really. I just... I don't know. There's nothing I really look forward to right now.
Are there any activities that you used to enjoy that you still do, even if you don't enjoy them as much as you used to?
No, I... I just don't really do much of anything right now.
Are you able to experience pleasure when doing things that normally would bring you happiness?
I don't think so. I mean... I can't really think of anything that makes me feel happy right now.
Are there any small things that you still find some pleasure in, like eating your favorite food or watching a movie?
No... not really. I just eat because I have to. I don't really care about watching anything. It's just... no.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in almost all activities you used to enjoy?
Yeah... pretty much. I just... I don't really want to do anything anymore.
Do you feel like there's anything you're still interested in doing?
No. I just... no. There's nothing.
Do you feel like you've lost all interest in things you used to enjoy?
I mean... yeah. Like I just said. I don't know what else to tell you... I just don't care about any of it anymore.
Do you feel like your lack of interest in things is a big change from how you used to be?
I don't know. I guess so. I haven't really thought about it like that... it's just how it is right now.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About four months, I think. Just... around the time the foreclosure notices started showing up.
Would you say that you have no interest or pleasure in almost all of the activities you do during the day?
I don't know about *all* of them. I just... I don't really get much out of anything right now. It's just getting through the day.
Would you say that your lack of interest in things is a significant change from how you used to feel before the foreclosure notices started?
I guess. I mean... I didn't really think about it back then. Things were just normal before, I suppose. Now it's just... different.
Do you feel like you no longer enjoy or look forward to things you used to find pleasurable?
I don't know. I guess... I just don't really think about looking forward to things right now. I'm not sure.
Would you say that you have lost interest or pleasure in almost all activities you used to enjoy?
I don't really know. It's hard to tell. I'm just... trying to get by right now. I haven't really been paying attention to whether I'm enjoying things or not.
Do you feel like you have lost all interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
I just... I don't know how to answer that. Like I said, I'm just trying to get through the day. I'm not really tracking if I'm having fun.
